blocks.html: The response of listing the shipping options for a cart.

types.name: shipping_options
types.description: The shipping options for the cart.

children.name: id
children.description: The shipping option's ID.

children.name: name
children.description: The shipping option's name.

children.name: price_type
children.description:
The type of the shipping option's price. `flat` means the price
is fixed, whereas `calculated` means the price is calculated by the
associated fulfillment provider.

children.name: service_zone_id
children.description: The ID of the associated service zone.

children.name: shipping_profile_id
children.description: The ID of the associated shipping profile.

children.name: provider_id
children.description: The ID of the fulfillment provider used to handle shipping.

children.name: data
children.description:
The data useful for the fulfillment provider when handling the shipment and fulfillment.

Learn more in [this documentation](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules/fulfillment/shipping-option#data-property).

children.name: type
children.description: The shipping option's type.

children.name: id
children.description: The type's ID.

children.name: label
children.description: The type's label.

children.name: description
children.description: The type's description.

children.name: code
children.description: The type's code.

children.name: provider
children.description: The details of the associated fulfillment provider.

children.name: id
children.description: The fulfillment provider's ID.

children.name: is_enabled
children.description: Whether the fulfillment provider is enabled.

children.name: amount
children.description:
The shipping option's amount for the cart. For a `calculated` shipping option,
this amount is resolved by the fulfillment provider against the cart.

children.name: prices
children.description:
The shipping option's stored prices. This is empty for a `calculated` shipping
option, since its price is computed by the fulfillment provider rather than stored.

children.name: id
children.description: The price's ID.

children.name: currency_code
children.description: The price's currency code.

children.name: amount
children.description: The price's amount.

children.name: min_quantity
children.description: The minimum quantity that must be available in the cart for the price to be applied.

children.name: max_quantity
children.description: The maximum quantity allowed to be available in the cart for the price to be applied.

children.name: price_rules
children.description: The rules enabled to enable the current price

children.name: calculated_price
children.description:
The shipping option's price resolved for the cart. For a `flat` shipping option,
this is the stored price matching the cart's context; for a `calculated` shipping
option, this is the price computed by the fulfillment provider for the cart.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the price set.

children.name: is_calculated_price_price_list
children.description:
Whether the calculated price is associated with a price list. During the calculation process, if no valid price list is found,
the calculated price is set to the original price, which doesn't belong to a price list. In that case, the value of this property is `false`.

children.name: is_calculated_price_tax_inclusive
children.description: Whether the calculated price is tax inclusive.

children.name: calculated_amount
children.description: The amount of the calculated price, or `null` if there isn't a calculated price.

children.name: calculated_amount_with_tax
children.description: The amount of the calculated price with taxes included. If the calculated price is tax inclusive, this field will be the same as `calculated_amount`.

children.name: calculated_amount_without_tax
children.description: The amount of the calculated price without taxes included. If the calculated price is tax exclusive, this field will be the same as `calculated_amount`.

children.name: is_original_price_price_list
children.description:
Whether the original price is associated with a price list. During the calculation process, if the price list of the calculated price is of type override,
the original price will be the same as the calculated price. In that case, the value of this property is `true`.

children.name: is_original_price_tax_inclusive
children.description: Whether the original price is tax inclusive.

children.name: original_amount
children.description:
The amount of the original price, or `null` if there isn't an original price.
This happens when the price set has no default (non-price-list) price and only
prices from price lists of type `sale` match the context.

children.name: original_amount_with_tax
children.description: The amount of the original price with taxes included. If the original price is tax inclusive, this field will be the same as `original_amount`.

children.name: original_amount_without_tax
children.description: The amount of the original price without taxes included. If the original price is tax exclusive, this field will be the same as `original_amount`.

children.name: currency_code
children.description: The currency code of the calculated price, or null if there isn't a calculated price.

children.name: calculated_price
children.description: The details of the calculated price.

children.name: original_price
children.description: The details of the original price.

children.name: insufficient_inventory
children.description: Whether the stock location of the shipping option has insufficient inventory for items in the cart.

children.name: service_zone
children.description: The associated service zone.

children.name: id
children.description: The service zone's ID.

children.name: fulfillment_set_id
children.description: The fulfillment set's id.

children.name: fulfillment_set
children.description: The details of the associated fulfillment set.
